framework: Existing pinned .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core shared framework
findings: Reuse ITicketStore and framework antiforgery instead of a custom session-token/crypto protocol.
Explicitly validate all unsafe methods, not only framework form-bound endpoints.
Set stable distinct application discriminators; no checkout-specific cookie namespace.
No implicit session lifetime/renewal; real sign-in remains disabled until owner work.
YARP, OAuth server, Identity implementation, proxy trust and production release are untriggered in this technical slice.

Windows Schannel ephemeral-key limitation was reproduced before the candidate. The test fixture imports a generated PKCS12 buffer with default non-PersistKeySet lifecycle, scrubs it, pins the exact certificate and disposes the temporary user key. No production TLS control was changed.
